indication: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy (adults, BSCVA criterion per Methods); organ-cultured grafts from two French regional tissue banks; Nd:YAG inferior iridotomy before surgery in all eyes

groups.description: Phacoemulsification immediately followed by DMEK in the same session (40 eyes of 34 patients)
DMEK in pseudophakic eyes, phacoemulsification done earlier (55 eyes of 43 patients)

donor graft ECD given only as median (range); medians are not admissible, so it cannot serve as the reference

notes: Retrospective cohort of consecutive FECD patients (2015-2019), single surgeon, at least 12 months follow-up; Methods state that data were complete for all analysed patients.
Eyes needing a second transplant (5 triple-DMEK, 8 pseudophakic-DMEK) were excluded from the statistical analysis by the authors, so postoperative values are conditional on graft survival.

Reference kind: Table 2 'Preoperative' ECD is recorded as patient_preoperative (Methods describe preoperative specular microscopy of the patients; the donor graft ECD is reported separately in Table 1 as median (range)). The two tables' preoperative and graft ranges are not identical and the article does not reconcile them, so the attribution to recipient or donor endothelium is unverified.
Both arms are standard DMEK variants without an investigational agent; both are control.
